_byKey.description: Function to compute the key from the element in the collection.

_keyType.description: Type of the key by which to group by.

title:
An intermediate structure holding results of the various groupBy operations on {@link Collection}, providing the
ability to perform various aggregations on the grouped result.

@var E
        Element Type of the collection. Collection Type to be  the same Type after doing the subsequent operation.
        (e.g.: If the collection which this operation is acting on is a DataTable, the output of the `agg` function
        should also be a DataTable.)

@see StdLib#groupBy
name: CollectionGroupBy
